description:
A load/re-export cycle corrupts bundles (all reproduced):
1. Plans destroyed: loaded results carry counts but no plan payloads, so
   re-export writes no .plans.json (partially fixed by qpc-01; this item
   asserts the property end-to-end).
2. Warmup rows become measurement rows: exporter writes iter: 0, loader
   keeps iteration only `if q.get("iter"):` (loader.py:448) — 0 is falsy —
   so re-export defaults iteration=1/run_type=measurement and warmup times
   pollute summary stats.
3. FAILED queries duplicate as phantom successes: loader hardcodes
   "status": "SUCCESS" for every queries[] entry (loader.py:446) and also
   appends a FAILED row from errors[].
Loader also drops run_type, stream 0, plan_fingerprint, plan_capture_time_ms.

Findings: F1.4 (and the `if capture_time:` 0.0-drop from F1.5).

anti_patterns.dont: 'fix' by making the exporter omit warmup rows
anti_patterns.why: warmup data is part of the record.

anti_patterns.dont: drop errors[] from the export format
anti_patterns.why: it is the legacy-load fallback; dedup on load instead.

preserves.behavior: Legacy bundles (queries[] without status/run_type keys) still load without error

prior_art.concept: benchbox/core/results/canonical_json.py — byte-stable form enables byte-equality round-trip test

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/results/test_loader.py -q -k roundtrip

verifications.description: No phantom SUCCESS rows for failed queries

work_units.notes: Rewrote loader with is-not-None checks for iter/stream/run_type; status now read per-entry (default SUCCESS for legacy); errors[] merges detail onto non-success rows and only synthesizes a standalone row when the query_id is absent from queries[] (legacy shape). Fixed schema.py capture_time falsy-check to `is not None`.
work_units.summary: Create: fix _reconstruct_query_results to honor status/run_type, keep iter/stream 0, dedupe errors[], and carry plan fields through.

work_units.notes: Added byte-equality roundtrip test (warmup iter0/stream0, FAILED dup, stream1+plan w/ capture_time_ms=0.0) plus two targeted loader tests (no phantom-dup for current-format failures; iter0/stream0 preserved).
work_units.summary: Create: round-trip property test — export, load, re-export must be byte-identical for both main file and plans companion.
Review: adversarial code review (legacy-bundle branch, errors[] dedup rules, summary-stat recomputation).
Fix: address review findings; re-run verification.
